content.name: Vardath - Living Factions and Builders
content.description: Allows player-owned builders running Find Build Tasks to respond to eligible NPC faction construction requests and attempts to pay a standard 50000-credit hire fee. Enables automatic requests from player build storages. Increases faction economy-driven station module growth, subject to vanilla construction resources, budgets and station plans. Experimental for X4 9.00; back up saves.
content.author: Vardath
